description: src/holon_coherence/proxy/wire_log.py appends futures into an unbounded _pending_wire_log_futures collection without completion pruning or queue capacity limits.
goal: Bound _pending_wire_log_futures in src/holon_coherence/proxy/wire_log.py (keeping it at most 200 lines and NEVER modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json): prune completed futures on submission, enforce a configurable maximum pending queue cap (WIRE_LOG_MAX_PENDING, default 256) that drops and counts overflow submissions instead of growing memory unboundedly, and expose a helper to inspect or reset dropped counts for tests. Add unit tests in tests/proxy/test_wire_log.py verifying completion pruning and bounded queue overflow counting. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: An unbounded list of pending executor futures leaks memory and retains completed payload references under heavy or slow wire-logging loads.
acceptance_criteria: src/holon_coherence/proxy/wire_log.py prunes completed futures, enforces WIRE_LOG_MAX_PENDING, tracks dropped overflow submissions without raising, and stays at most 200 lines without touching holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
tests/proxy/test_wire_log.py verifies bounded queue enforcement and completion pruning with zero docstrings or comments, and 'uv run pytest' plus 'uv run task lint' pass.
